title.purpose: The card headline; grows as the board zooms out.

body.purpose: Supporting detail, clamped to 4 lines, dropped when zoomed out.

label.purpose: The status badge. Always written out, never colour alone.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: The only elevation in the system. Top bar and toolbar, which genuinely hover over live canvas.

shadows.name: next-up-glow
shadows.purpose: Attention, not elevation. Exactly one card at a time.

motion.name: draw-in
motion.purpose: The signature: lines appear to be drawn. Resolves instantly under reduced motion.

motion.name: write-in
motion.purpose: Card text fades in after its box is sketched.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Hover and active feedback on chrome.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The word that carries a card's state. Never replaced by colour alone.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', cursive); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffd35c; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 7px; line-height: 1.35; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Control Button
components.description: A quiet instrument: invisible until reached for, crisp when engaged.
components.css: .ds-control { font-family: var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', cursive); font-size: 16px; color: #f4efe6; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-control:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd35c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-control[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(255, 211, 92, 0.18); }

components.name: Next Banner
components.description: The single loud thing: what to do next. Opaque, not glass.
components.css: .ds-next { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 18px; font-family: var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', cursive); font-size: 16px; color: #f4efe6; background: #2a2110; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,184,48,0.55); border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-next-label { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: #ffb830; } .ds-next:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd35c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A mark on the page, not an object resting on it: outline only, no fill, no shadow.
components.html:
to do
Turn ads on for real
After payment, smoke test and Stripe.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 220px; padding: 10px 14px 12px; border: 3px solid #6cc4ff; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font-family: var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', cursive); } .ds-card-status { align-self: flex-start; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6cc4ff; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 7px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.05; color: #f4efe6; } .ds-card-note { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.2; color: #9a978f; }

components.name: Memory Slot
components.description: Saved-arrangement recall, styled like a car's memory-seat button. Empty slots stay faint.
components.css: .ds-slots { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-slot { min-width: 26px; padding: 5px 7px; font-family: var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', cursive); font-size: 14px; color: #f4efe6; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; opacity: 0.4; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slot--filled { opacity: 1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-color: rgba(244,239,230,0.14); } .ds-slot:disabled { cursor: default; } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd35c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inline Editor Field
components.description: Edits a card in place. Focus shifts the border to gold; the ring is never removed.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', cursive); font-size: 17px; color: #f4efe6; background: rgba(128,128,128,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(244,239,230,0.14); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(255,211,92,0.6); }

narrative.overview: Drafting pencil on dark paper. Every mark is hand-drawn, but by someone good at it doing serious technical work. That image resolves the system's central tension: the medium is literally crayon, and the constant risk is tipping into a children's app. The board is the product; chrome exists only to get out of its way. Colour is scarce and semantic, and the only thing permitted to shout is the single card that is next.
keyCharacteristics: Hand-drawn surface, precise substructure - wobble on top, discipline beneath
Flat board; only genuinely floating chrome casts a shadow
One accent, one gold, and status colour used semantically and nowhere else
Legibility survives zoom: detail is dropped, never shrunk into illegibility
Nothing on the board is carried by colour alone

rules.name: The One Loud Thing Rule
rules.body: Gold marks exactly one card: the next action. Highlighting the whole critical path highlights nothing.

rules.name: The Semantic Pigment Rule
rules.body: The status colours are prohibited as decoration. If a colour appears on something not conveying state, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Every status label clears 4.5:1 against its board in both themes.

rules.name: The Grows-When-Small Rule
rules.body: Text scales up as the board zooms out, never down. Shrinking type to fit more board is forbidden.

rules.name: The Six Word Rule
rules.body: Card titles run to about six words. Long titles are a content bug, not a layout problem.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Object Rule
rules.body: A card is a mark on the page, never a card resting on the page. A shadow kills the sketchbook illusion.

rules.name: The Earned Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter is permitted only on surfaces that persistently float over live canvas. Blur as a default look is prohibited.

dos: Do keep the board flat and let only the top bar and toolbar cast a shadow.
Do reserve gold for the single next action and the progress ring.
Do write out the status word - colour never carries state alone.
Do grow type and drop detail as the board zooms out.
Do keep every status label above 4.5:1 in both themes.
Do draw each stroke exactly once, with the wobble intact.
Do give every control a visible keyboard focus ring.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard - no purple gradients, no identical stat-card grids, no hero-metric block.
Don't let it become childish or toy-like: no bounce easing, no rainbow palettes, no cartoon stickers.
Don't turn it into a cluttered whiteboard - every new panel or control must displace one that exists.
Don't correct the childish risk by going cold and corporate.
Don't put a shadow on a card, a section, or an edge.
Don't use backdrop-filter on anything not persistently floating over the canvas.
Don't add a second font family.
Don't shrink text to make more of the board fit.
Don't highlight the whole critical path - one loud thing only.
Don't suppress an animation in a way that leaves geometry invisible.
